_note: Where the units web sites live. The docs are a site of their own (apps/docs, scripts/docs/build.ts, scripts/docs/deploy.sh) whose canonical origin is always docs_canonical. app_url: the app the docs link to and read live figures from (Explorer and Launch in the docs header, every app: link, GET /v1/config, /v1/stats, /v1/guard-config and /market/tokens); the devnet site until the owner's app domain exists, then that domain. docs_url: where the app's /docs redirects and in-app docs links go; the temporary docs host until the DNS record of docs.units.gg exists, then https://docs.units.gg. The environment overrides them for one build or one server: UNITS_APP_URL (docs build), UNITS_DOCS_URL (app server, app bundles, deploy kit). After a change of app_url run bun scripts/docs/build.ts once: it rewrites apps/docs/vercel.json (the docs page policy names the app origin) and the docs test fails until it is committed.
